 About the claude-artifacts — Delete Artifact Tool:
 │ Permanently delete an artifact the user owns. Every version and file is removed, and its link stops working for everyone it was shared with. This cannot be undone. Call it only when the user
 │ has asked to delete this artifact; the user is asked to confirm each call. An artifact someone else owns cannot be deleted, even one the user can edit.
